thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call — increased 5xx rate and p95 latency for user-facing inference endpoints in us-west-3. Alert: ALB health checks failing in az-b, targets draining. Correlating with regional control-plane API errors.

mike_oncall: Acked. Looking now. Any customer-visible error pages?

sara_sre: seeing a spike in connection resets from the regional gateway. Noted 30-40% target unhealthy on app load balancer in az-b.

mike_oncall: running quick checks: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --region us-west-3` shows many targets in "unknown" then "draining". Also `curl -I https://edge-proxy.us-west-3.redwood.internal/health` returns 502 intermittently.

raj_engineering: stack telemetry shows NAT SNAT connection count saturating on several NAT gateways in az-b around the same time. Could be ephemeral port exhaustion causing upstream resets.

emily_ops: customer impact: approx 12% of API requests fail with 502 from that region; some long-tail latency for cross-region fallbacks. We're seeing increased error noise on paged customers in APAC.

infra-bot: Automated mitigation suggestion: spin new NAT gateway pair in az-c and add route to private subnets; enable proxy auto-scale for edge-proxy group. Recommend DNS failover to us-west-2 for critical routes.

mike_oncall: Taking mitigation step 1: launching replacement NATs in az-c, adding them to private subnet route tables — running `aws ec2 create-nat-gateway ...` now. ETA ~4m. Also increasing edge-proxy ASG desired from 8 -> 20 in us-west-3.

raj_engineering: On the app side, enabling aggressive connection reuse and reducing ephemeral port churn in the proxy config: patching `env.CONN_TIMEOUT` from 30s -> 60s and toggling `SO_REUSEPORT`. Pushing canary to 2 instances.

mike_oncall: Update: new NATs active, route tables updated. ALB target health slowly improving from 60% -> 85%. 5xx rate decreasing but still above baseline.

statuspage: Preparing update: "We are investigating increased error rates and latency impacting a subset of customers in the us-west-3 region. Mitigation in progress." Will publish once we have stable numbers for impact and ETA.

sara_sre: Handoff: mike, do you want to keep it or should I take post-incident lead? Remaining work: confirm long-term remediation (replace NAT design / add autoscaling for NATs), verify control-plane error root cause with cloud provider, and coordinate postmortem and customer comms.

mike_oncall: I'll hand off to you in 10m — will stay on the channel for questions. Current status: error rate down ~70% from peak, most targets healthy, cross-region fallbacks functioning. Logging snapshot and relevant graphs uploaded to incident binder.

sara_sre: Taking over. Action items assigned: 1) follow up w/ cloud provider support on control-plane API errors, 2) schedule infra change to adopt NAT autoscale and more retry-safe health checks, 3) draft postmortem and affected-customer list.

emily_ops: Noted — customer comms draft will be ready for review in 20m. Please add any impacted account IDs to the doc.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Continue monitoring; reopen if errors creep back above threshold.

sara_sre: Closing handoff. Logging final note: short-term mitigation achieved by moving NAT egress and scaling edge proxies; investigating root cause with provider. Postmortem will include impact window and recommended infra changes.
